CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 06 / 12

Production possibilities frontier (PPF)

PPF opportunity costPPF 機會成本

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate the opportunity cost of one good in units of the other from a table or a PPF's slope. Interpret its magnitude and units.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

每多一單位 X 的機會成本是放棄的 Y 除以增加的 X。Y 在縱軸時，這是斜率的絕對值；答案要寫商品單位。

The opportunity cost of one extra X is Y sacrificed divided by additional X. With Y on the vertical axis, it is the magnitude of the PPF slope. Always state units.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：From (2,10) to (4,4), ΔX=2 and Y lost=6. Cost of 1 X=3 Y. 每單位 X 放棄三單位 Y。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Moving from (X=1,Y=12) to (X=3,Y=8), cost per extra X? 每單位 X 成本？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
